characters.name: Laverne
characters.description: One of the two titular protagonists. She grew up in Brooklyn, and she is tougher, more outspoken and more tomboyish than Shirley. And more boy-crazy too. Adaptational Dye-Job: In the cartoon, she's a redhead, whereas in the original series, she has a sort of dark blonde or light brown shade of hair. Bizarre Taste in Food: Or drink, rather - she drinks milk and Pepsi mixed together. Brooklyn Rage: Originally from Brooklyn before moving to Milwaukee, she can be quite the tough-talker. Brought To You By The Letter "L": Most of her shirts, sweaters, and dresses have a cursive "L" attached, usually made of felt and on her left-hand side. This extends to other possessions (like her luggage), too. If Laverne can claim it as hers, you can bet she'll adorn it with one of her "L"s.

characters.name: Shirley
characters.description: The other titular protagonist; smaller, with darker hair. More emotional than Laverne, but also more of a scheme-maker. Also more of an animal lover. A-Cup Angst: Implied a few times. She stuffs her dress with tissues in "Call Me a Taxi", and there's this bit from "Drive! She Said":Laverne, after Shirley agrees to teach her to drive:[yelling out the window]Shirley Feeney don't stuff socks in her bra! ...anymore! Animal Lover: As demonstrated in several episodes, notably "One Flew Over Milwaukee" and "It's a Dog's Life," she'll go to extremes to care for animals that she believes need her help. Determinator: Like Laverne, she's not a quitter. Drama Queen: While she's generally happy-go-lucky, she'll overact a lot if she's in a bad mood.

characters.name: Lenny
characters.description: One of the title characters' wacky upstairs neighbors, and childhood friend. Truck driver, musician, teamster, and of Polish descent. Often his best friend Squiggy's loyal stooge. Book Dumb: Mentioned to have taken remedial reading multiple times. Cloudcuckoolander: Most of his date with Amy was spent teaching her how to do wacky things like he does. The Ditz: Although he's more uncultured than outright stupid. Drop-In Character: Often enters the apartment of Laverne and Shirley without knocking with Squiggy, who always enters first saying "Hello!".

characters.name: Squiggy
characters.description: Lenny's roommate. A greaser, but definitelynotlike Fonzie. Catchphrase: "Hello!" Determinator: He may be a bit "slow", but he's very determined. Disappeared Dad: His father abandoned him. The Ditz: Not very bright, but a bit smarter than Lenny.

characters.name: Carmine
characters.description: Shirley's on-and-off boyfriend. A singer and actor by trade, as well as an amateur boxer. Beware the Nice Ones: Is a very friendly and upbeat guy who also happens to be Golden Gloves boxing champ of Milwaukee. In-Series Nickname: Calls himself "The Big Ragoo". Large Ham: He enters and exits by while singing and dancing. Spell My Name with a "The": Gets calledTheBig Ragoo.

characters.name: Frank
characters.description: Laverne's widowed father, an Italian immigrant who runs a pizzeria/bowling alley, the "Pizza Bowl", in Milwaukee. Later opens up the "Cowboy Bills" in Burbank. Contrasting Replacement Character: A louder, lessExtreme Doormatversion of Al Delvecchio, the Italian-American restaurant owner of Arnold's Drive-In inHappy Days. Dad the Veteran: He used to be in the army. December–December Romance: With Edna, the landlady of Laverne and Shirley in Milwaukee. Immigrant Parents: He was born in Italy and moved to the USA, then he fathered Laverne.

characters.name: Edna
characters.description: The landlady of Laverne and Shirley's apartment, who has had many previous marriages. December–December Romance: With Laverne's father Frank. Second Love: Ends up marrying the widowed Frank.

characters.name: Rhonda
characters.description: A vain actress who lives next door to the girls during the Burbank seasons. Drop-In Character: Has no qualms about randomly entering the girls' kitchen via the backdoor with a "Heigh-ho! Rhonda's here!" Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Arrogant and rude, but decent on the inside. Third-Person Person: She usually speaks in the third person.

characters.name: Sonny
characters.description: The landlord of Laverne, Shirley and Rhonda in Burbank and a stuntman. He dates Laverne at one point.
